Keep this Dependencies folder beside ForzaPort.exe.
Resources are detected automatically when supplied in these locations:

ModelProbe/ModelProbe.dll - complete matching helper and its dependencies.
TextureRuntime/xg_x.dll and kernelx.dll - separately supplied texture libraries.
TextureRuntime/xg.dll - native Xbox One PC XG library for AO alpha adaptation.
This is not Azimuth's similarly named adapter; never copy it into the game.
SourceResources/gamedbRC.decrypted.sqlite - your readable FH6 database.
SourceResources/Materials.zip - your FH6 source materials archive.
Runtime/ - supplied official Extra Options runtime, license and corresponding source.

Install Microsoft .NET 8 x64 Runtime separately. Python is already in the EXE.
Choose your FH2/Azimuth folder in Settings; no directory is hardcoded.
Missing resources are explained by Check setup. Advanced paths support other locations.

Keep all supplied notices, credits and runtime corresponding source.
Each tester supplies their own game archives, source database and materials.
An exported converted package does not acquire newer conversion fixes on install:
reconvert its original source archive to apply those fixes.
